title: Meet the 2026 App Store Award finalists
summary: Apple announced the finalists for the 2026 App Store Awards, recognizing 45 developers from around the world for exceptional apps and games.
body_markdown:
Text of this article


November 18, 2026


UPDATE


Meet the 2026 App Store Award finalists


Global App Store editors recognize 45 app and game developers for their exceptional user experience, design, innovation, and cultural impact


Today, Apple announced 45 finalists for this year’s App Store Awards, celebrating developers from around the world whose apps and games exemplify the very best in technical innovation, user experience, and design. This year’s finalists span iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision Pro, Apple Watch, Apple TV, and Apple Arcade, as well as the Cultural Impact category. Winners will be announced in the coming weeks.


“We’re excited to celebrate this year’s App Store Award finalists, whose creativity has brought extraordinary apps and games to life for users around the world,” said Carson Oliver, Apple’s vice president of App Store. “From games that transport players to imaginative new worlds and bring out the fun of playing together, to apps that empower users to learn new skills and make a difference in their communities, these developers are redefining how we connect, create, and experience the world.”


**iPhone App of the Year Finalists**


[ElevenReader](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/elevenreader-read-books-aloud/id6479373050/) , for reading aloud text in surprisingly natural-sounding AI voices.
[(Not Boring) Camera](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/not-boring-camera/id6737783441/) , for transforming iPhone into a customizable old-school camera.
[Raylie](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/raylie-flight-view-guide/id6793443320/) , for offering a personalized, guided journey for every flight.


**iPhone Game of the Year Finalists**


[BALL x PIT](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ball-x-pit/id6738703497/) , for breaking the mold of brick breakers.
[DAVE THE DIVER](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dave-the-diver/id6759962259/) , for exploring the oceans deep.
[Gambonanza](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/gambonanza/id6747752407/) , for rewiring the rules of chess.


**iPad App of the Year Finalists**


[Cosmos](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cosmos-search-discover/id1577975475/) , for inspiring users with a gorgeous mood board.
[Kiddopia](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kiddopia-kids-learning-games/id1223397201/) , for giving little ones a joyful space to learn and play.
[Mockup](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/mockup-ui-ux-design/id1527554407/) , for helping everyone design the website or app of their dreams.


**iPad Game of the Year Finalists**


[Aniimo](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/aniimo/id6759098797/) , for forging fantasy quests with truly adorable creatures.
[Arknights: Endfield](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/arknights-endfield/id6752642477/) , for waging stunning battles on a faraway moon.
[Where Winds Meet](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/where-winds-meet/id6472396866/) , for creating cinematic martial arts moves.


**Mac App of the Year Finalists**


[Paste](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/paste-limitless-clipboard/id967805235/) , for supercharging the Mac Clipboard.
[Things 3](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/things-3/id904237743/) , for tackling tasks with simplicity.
[Ulysses](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ulysses-writing-app/id1225570693/) , for making it easy to create beautifully styled documents.


**Mac Game of the Year Finalists**


[Big Walk](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/big-walk/id6773484032?mt=12/) , for encouraging friends to puzzle together.
[Blue Prince](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/blue-prince/id6752822014?mt=12/) , for delivering a mysterious mansion full of unexpected twists.
[Crimson Desert](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/crimson-desert-enhanced/id6747100856?mt=12/) , for creating a sprawling war-torn fantasyland.


**Apple Arcade Game of the Year Finalists**


[Perchang World](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/perchang-world/id6477922353/) , for stumping players with marble-filled physics puzzles.
[PowerWash Simulator](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/powerwash-simulator/id6477445344/) , for making fighting grime so satisfying.
[Pusheen’s Place](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pusheens-place/id6502513973/) , for captivating users with really cute cats.


**Apple Vision Pro App of the Year Finalists**


[Adobe Premiere](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/adobe-premiere-ai-video-editor/id6742757464/) , for letting creators edit video on an expansive spatial canvas.
[MLB](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/mlb/id493619333/) , for livestreaming baseball games from behind home plate.
[Museas](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/museas/id6496682427/) , for turning the living room into a gorgeous art gallery.


**Apple Vision Pro Game of the Year Finalists**


[Cueva de las Manos](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cueva-de-las-manos/id6777099953/) , for designing one-of-a-kind puzzles that play with light and shadow.
[Ping Pong Club](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ping-pong-club-table-tennis/id6739363110/) , for bringing smashing rounds of table tennis.
[Spatial Ops](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/spatial-ops-campaign-edition/id6742558471/) , for immersing players in first-person battles that go down right in their home.


**Apple Watch App of the Year Finalists**


[Bevel](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bevel-ai-health-coach/id6456176249/) , for turning fitness data into actionable insights.
[Moonlitt](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/moonlitt-moon-phase-tracker/id6444718902/) , for highlighting upcoming lunar events.
[StressWatch](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/stresswatch-ai-stress-monitor/id6444737095/) , for reporting real-time stress levels.


**Apple TV App of the Year Finalists**


[Case Solved: The London Files](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/case-solved-the-london-files/id6769660234/) , for weaving fun logic puzzles into a noir murder mystery.
[Letterboxd](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/letterboxd/id1054271011/) , for putting movie recommendations from critics and friends in one place.
[Pocket Casts](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pocket-casts-podcast-player/id414834813/) , for bringing podcasts to the big screen.


**Cultural Impact App Finalists**


[Brilliant](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brilliant-learn-math-coding/id913335252/) , for teaching the foundations of math and science.
[chilli](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/chilli-take-action-today/id1645549437/) , for making it easy to take political action for the planet.
[Hearing Buddy](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hearing-buddy-speech-to-text/id6747363502/) , for helping people who are deaf or hard of hearing follow the conversation.
[Karrot](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/karrot-buy-sell-locally/id1018769995/) , for enabling circular economies among neighbors.
[setlog](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/setlog-friends-camera/id6587576438/) , for bringing more authenticity to social media.
[Unedo](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/unedo-spanish-games-stories/id6503170902/) , for making learning Spanish a playful cultural journey.


**Cultural Impact Game Finalists**


[and Roger](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/and-roger/id6761811652/) , for telling a poignant and often challenging personal story.
[Consume Me](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/consume-me/id6769877287/) , for grappling with the realities of eating disorders.
[PancitoMerge](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pancitomerge/id6759935383/) , for celebrating Mexico’s culinary culture.
[Sago Mini Jinja’s Garden](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sago-mini-jinjas-garden/id6477492925/) , for giving families a way to play together.
[Spilled!](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/spilled/id6752525411/) , for making it fun to clean up polluted waterways.
[Tiny Bookshop](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tiny-bookshop/id6766267906/) , for bringing a cozy, inclusive community to life.
